references.context: Module theory: linear homomorphism in one argument of a two-variable mapping holding the other argument fixed

references.disposition: Both separate linearity requirements are imposed, rather than a single linearity condition on M×N.

review_rationale: Read both independent variable-linearity clauses, including the role of fixed elements in the other input and the shared R-module structure. For noncommutative rings, sidedness would need separate conventions not supplied by this formulation.
